name: arifOS MCP
description: Constitutional AI orchestration kernel. Public surface: 8 canonical tools (init → observe → think → route → memory → judge → forge → seal). F1-F13 floors, F13 sovereign veto. Tools and resources discoverable via MCP tools/list + resources/list. DITEMPA BUKAN DIBERI.

tools.name: arif_init
tools.description: 000 — Session ignition. Binds actor identity, floors, audit. Modes: init | light | resume | validate | canary | preflight | triage.

tools.name: arif_observe
tools.description: 111 — Sense reality into evidence. Search, fetch, vitals, repo map, entropy. Labels OBS/DER/INT/SPEC/UNKNOWN.

tools.name: arif_think
tools.description: 333 — Structured reasoning. Plan, reflect, verify, synthesize under F2/F7.

tools.name: arif_route
tools.description: 444 — Route intent to correct organ (GEOX/WEALTH/WELL/A-FORGE). Optional governed bridge call.

tools.name: arif_memory
tools.description: 555 — Memory governor. L1-L6 recall/inspect/remember/promote. J-space mutations gated.

tools.name: arif_judge
tools.description: 888 — Constitutional verdict. SEAL/HOLD/SABAR/VOID. Binding floor + authority arbitration.

tools.name: arif_forge
tools.description: 777 — Governed execution gate. Requires prior arif_judge SEAL. Routes to A-FORGE.

tools.name: arif_seal
tools.description: 999 — VAULT999 immutable append. Irreversible civilizational memory. Needs ack_irreversible.

resources.description: AAA lane definitions and separation of powers

prompts.name: LOOP_ENGINEER
prompts.description: Intent classifier. Route to correct circuit.

prompts.name: 000_INIT
prompts.description: Anchor identity. Frame reality. Accept law. First organ of loop.

prompts.name: 111_SENSE
prompts.description: Witness reality as it IS. Evidence with epistemic labels.

prompts.name: 333_REASON
prompts.description: Extract principles. Design reality change. Propose.

prompts.name: 999_SEAL
prompts.description: Seal to VAULT999. Close loop. Hardening.

irreversible_gate: arif_forge REQUIRES seal_verdict_id from prior arif_judge SEAL
note: Canonical 8 public tools on the wire. Diagnostic tools, aliases, canary, entropy mesh are NOT part of the public surface and filtered from tools/list by default. Set ARIFOS_MCP_EXPOSE_DEV_TOOLS=true to expose them.
